title: The M5 solver set: whole results, scored and checked trajectories, the rules on 16 problems, self-play kept
request: Grow the M5 training set (an LLM that solves ML problems on business tables honestly, toward the top of MLE-bench) from its 4 train rows: fix the builder, run the rules' standard plan on many problems, keep self-play, add kept-against-refused pairs; Claude's runs only on the owner's yes.
spec: Plan yes-you-are-right-jaunty-parasol, step 1 (fix the builder) and step 2 (the rules on many problems); the store's M5 set, the intern's session steps, the store keepers.
plan: the intern saves each step's whole result (cells removed), never only a 360-character summary
the builder adds the holdout score, the table it ran on (one table, one split), the planted truth's verdict and who acted
rules or local runs to trajectories/studio; Claude, GPT or any hosted model to trajectories/silver_frontier (weight 0.5, consent improve)
a runner for the standard plan on every studied sample, blind, the outcome named
the store keeps self-play's solves and their ledgers

decisions.decision: A run counts as clean only when the rules or a local model made every move and no hosted model wrote any of its results
decisions.why: the owner's rule: Claude's outputs are evaluation by default, silver only tagged, apart and lower weight

decisions.decision: A model is local only on its name's evidence (an Ollama tag with no provider before the colon and no path, or a local/tuned prefix)
decisions.why: a hosted model named like a tag (groq:llama-3.3-70b, Qwen/...:novita) passed as local in review

decisions.decision: The solver runs name the outcome in the task and hide the R&D's known leak columns
decisions.why: the standard plan refuses to pick an outcome (the owner's rule, 2026-10-13), which is why blind twin tasks stopped after describing the data; hiding the leaks keeps the truth check honest (a sample's own suggestion would hand the rules the answer)

decisions.decision: Sealed once, sealed always: a new set version keeps every raw entry an earlier version sealed
decisions.why: v1 of the development set sealed every row under one broken id; v2's new split would have put 302 of those rows in train

decisions.decision: A score is the session's only if its final completed inside one of its own final calls
decisions.why: a session that only read an existing project, or ran run_all over finished stages, was credited with a final someone else made

decisions.decision: Self-play solves are kept as the owner's own runs (consent train): invented tables, no person
decisions.why: 200 verified solves with every decision and its planted-truth label sat in lake/bronze and never reached the store

change: dclab_rnd/intern/loop.py step_record (whole result and arguments, scrubbed, NaN removed); dclab_rnd/store/shapers.py (intern/<id>.json an intern session, the session id kept, every string under a words key redacted, shapers-6); dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (holdouts, twin truths, answerer, final windows, sealed tables, keep_sealed, place, subagent ids, outcome_named); dclab_rnd/store/sets/__init__.py (write_set consent); dclab_rnd/twin/solver_runs.py (new); dclab_rnd/store/keepers (self-play workspaces); tests/test_store_m5_trajectories.py (new).

findings.scenario: the store's M5 set had 4 train rows
findings.impact: most intern sessions lost to M5

findings.defect: every Claude Code session id was redacted to [ID]
findings.scenario: 334 development trajectories under one id, all sealed
findings.cause: session was not an id key
findings.fix: session added to the id keys

findings.defect: the intern kept only a 360-character summary of each tool result
findings.scenario: training rows ended in an ellipsis
findings.fix: step_record saves the whole result, cells removed
findings.impact: against the owner's rule never truncate before saving

findings.defect: old sessions' summaries quoted table cells into train rows
findings.scenario: bank_marketing ages 58, 44, 33 in studio v2 train
findings.cause: summaries were never scrubbed; the builder fell back to them
findings.fix: a step without a whole result keeps none, results_cut true; summaries built from the scrubbed result

findings.defect: a sealed session's trajectory went to train
findings.scenario: session 1da690c146c8, sealed record, train through its table's hash
findings.cause: the table split overrode the record's
findings.fix: a table any sealed session or sealed final touched is sealed for all

findings.defect: a twin lane with no verdict passed as checked
findings.scenario: a workspace name cut at 100 characters, a run stopped before the judge
findings.fix: unknown for a twin lane without a verdict, kept out
findings.impact: unchecked runs in the clean set

findings.cause: any unknown name was local, then any name:tag
findings.fix: local only on an Ollama tag with no provider and no path, or a local prefix
findings.impact: hosted output in the clean set
alternatives: the endpoint host from the usage log
findings.open: read the endpoint when the usage log is joined

findings.defect: nested strings in the whole result were not redacted
findings.fix: every string under a words key redacted; task a words key
findings.impact: a person's contact in training data

findings.defect: a version bump moved sealed rows to train
findings.scenario: 302 of development v2's train rows were sealed in v1
findings.cause: write_set guards sealed rows within one version only
findings.fix: keep_sealed reads every earlier version's sealed files
alternatives: the owner records v1 was never read

findings.defect: a score was credited to a session that did not make it
findings.scenario: run_all over finished stages; a cleared final's old version
findings.cause: any ok final call credited the project's final
findings.fix: the final must complete inside the session's own final call; run_programme removed
findings.impact: a person's or Claude's score filed as the rules'

findings.cause: each subagent's transcript carries its parent's session id
findings.fix: a subagent is its own trajectory, in its parent's split

findings.defect: the standard plan stopped after describing the data on 4 of 6 blind twin runs
findings.cause: by design: DCLab never picks the outcome; the blind task named none
findings.fix: the solver runs name the outcome as a person would, the leaks hidden
alternatives: let the rules guess (refused: the owner's rule)

findings.defect: self-play was never kept by the store
findings.scenario: 0 selfplay entries in the catalog; 200 solves in lake/bronze
findings.fix: self-play workspaces, ledgers filed as decisions
findings.impact: M1, M3, M5, M6 data lost

measurements.name: the rules' standard plan on the 16 studied samples, blind, the outcome named
measurements.gate: at least 10 of the 16 runs pass their planted truth (target and leak columns)
measurements.result: 14 of the 16 passed; online_shoppers missed activity columns known only after the visit, credit_card_fraud forbade its time column as a leak
measurements.next: self-play solves for more tables; the rules' leak finder on activity columns
limits: 16 tables only: a repeat adds no new problem

outcome: The M5 builder places only scored, checked, clean runs; the rules ran blind with the outcome named on every studied sample; self-play reaches the store.
lessons: A count that looks low may be a rule working: read the session's last words before fixing the code.
A new version of a set must carry its sealed rows forward.
risks: the 16 samples are 16 tables only: repeats add no new problems
self-play replicas are invented: a model may learn their shapes
